text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With so much overtime over the past few days,
getting back right before curfew has basically become routine.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's running again today.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Haah, haah, haah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Ah, um... Excuse me, is it curfew already...?
choice_data_list: No, you work so hard every day that I just wanted to say hi.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... If I don't do at least this much...
there's no way... I'll ever catch up...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My sisters…… are so much, far more――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Verxina and Vivlos...
Both my big sister and little sister are strong and fast, totally unlike me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ever since we were little, I've never been able to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: No matter how fast I ran, the two of them remained so far ahead――
choice_data_list: Still, you want to catch up, don't you?
Still, you want to catch up, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: You're always working hard late into the night, aren't you?
You always work so hard late into the night, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know it's hard, but... um, I don't want to give up.
Even if I look stubborn and graceless... I can't stand leaving it like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind her halting words, I can sense an unwavering resolve.
Her running form isn't bad either—she can definitely become stronger. All that's left is—
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll catch up someday.
I know you'll catch up to them someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall seeing her on my way home from work these past few days.
Running tirelessly over and over, she was showing signs of growth, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The unyielding resolve she held inside was definitely translating into results—gazing into her wavering eyes, I made sure she understood that.
choice_data_list: So, I think you can have more confidence in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You might just be trying to be considerate, but...
I'm really not used to hearing things like that...
So, um... thank you, very much.
choice_data_list: I'm not just flattering you. I'm sure you can catch up.
At the very least, you should be proud of your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really... think so...?
choice_data_list: Might not mean much coming from me, but...
It might not sound convincing coming from me, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...! It's just that I'm hopelessly
lacking in self-confidence... Um, your words
really did make me, um, happy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I will continue my training, then...
If you will excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Stamina, you say...?
choice_data_list: You'd be able to keep running late into the evening every day, right?
You should be able to keep running late into the evening every day.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: You have every right to be proud.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ........I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay to feel proud...
